description: This source file defines the NotificationsHandler class and related interfaces/objects responsible for managing device notifications, handling notification actions, and interacting with the notification system in an Android app. It includes methods for processing notification lists and actions, as well as internal state management via the NotificationsStateProvider interface.

classes.name: NotificationsStateProvider
classes.description: An internal interface defining methods for reading notification snapshot, requesting rebind, and executing notification actions.

classes.name: SystemNotificationsStateProvider
classes.description: A singleton object implementing NotificationsStateProvider to interact with device notification listener service.

classes.name: NotificationsHandler
classes.description: Main class that processes notification-related requests, manages notification state, and executes actions based on JSON parameters.

methods.name: handleNotificationsList
methods.description: Handles a request to retrieve the current list of notifications, returning a serialized JSON snapshot.

methods.name: handleNotificationsActions
methods.description: Processes a request to perform an action on a notification, such as open, dismiss, or reply, based on provided JSON parameters.

methods.name: readSnapshotWithRebind
methods.description: Reads the current notification snapshot and requests rebind if notifications are enabled but not connected.

methods.name: snapshotPayloadJson
methods.description: Serializes the notification snapshot into a JSON string.

methods.name: parseParamsObject
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a JsonObject, or returns null if parsing fails.

methods.name: readString
methods.description: Extracts a trimmed string value from a JsonObject for a given key.
